payload.reasoning_hinge_summary: The candidate must synthesize the force balance condition (Weight = Drag) with geometric scaling laws (Mass ∝ r³, Area ∝ r²) to determine how terminal velocity scales with mass.
payload.expected_mid_student_error: Students will likely fail to correctly link the mass ratio to the area ratio, often assuming linear scaling (e.g., Area ∝ Mass) or failing to account for the square root dependency of velocity on the drag force.
notes: The logic is compact and avoids multi-law extension by focusing purely on the proportionality chain.
The use of ratios makes this an ideal 'no-calculator' problem that tests conceptual fluency over arithmetic.
